circular-queue.main.c:
#include <stdio.h>
int main(void){int n,a[5],head=0,tail=0,size=0,x;char cmd;if(scanf("%d",&n)!=1)return 1;for(int i=0;i<n;i++){if(scanf(" %c",&cmd)!=1)return 1;if(cmd=='E'){if(scanf("%d",&x)!=1)return 1;a[tail]=x;tail=(tail+1)%5;size++;}else{head=(head+1)%5;size--;}}printf("size=%d front=%d\n",size,size?a[head]:-1);return 0;}
